notes.title: First PlayClaw 6 beta
notes.content:
We worked hard to prepare this major update. Or, may be, almost new software - PlayClaw 6.
We've changed the core of our software a bit. Overlays are the very important thing, other features are just useful "addons".
Here is how PlayClaw 6 looks after the first start.

[i] Overlay editor with realtime preview and dashboard to fast access common overlays properties.[/i]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5066236/f7ba15b843232156b1d5518beb194a3a73d4aa44.png[/img]

You can add up to 255 overlays using right mouse button click on preview or dashboard.

[i]Set of overlays[/i]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5066236/66f9a79a6fdcc319cfbda7259feb80466dfc3708.png[/img]

PlayClaw 6 supports interactive mode with overlays (if overlay can do it). Double click on overlay opens a "door".

[i]Interactive with browser overlay[/i]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5066236/fd431041a727ab63657f00f95b1f450fb52a8e48.png[/img]

Overlays have a set of common settings. Some of them are new for PlayClaw.

[i]Render layer to draw specific overlay over or under others[/i]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5066236/a8c3b02d26b8c302dac78409e3d465de999af9e2.png[/img]
[i]Visibility mode for every overlay[/i]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5066236/7f6d617ca2430307966c97a2db5bd5c525943e25.png[/img]

PlayClaw 6 supports Scenes management. You can prepare scene for every your game or streaming mode and just switch them in one-two clicks.

[i]Scenes management[/i]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5066236/44f560eb581790b0587a9ef5ffb98fe32714a843.png[/img]


We've optimized our capture and encoding engine and version 6 does its job 2x faster than version 5. FPS drop during capture is very low, really.
[b]This beta has limited set of available overlays.[/b]
This beta can have bugs :)
This beta is free for all PlayClaw 5 steam owners.
We plan to make paid upgrade to v6, but it will cost only a few USD.

To install this beta you need to open software properties in Steam client and select "version-6" beta in Betas tab. Steam will start download after closing properties window.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5066236/aa27b0c31ac1dfb3f8804515a89e907a2366cddb.png[/img]

notes.title: Teamspeak 3 plugins update and more!
notes.content:
This new version #3700 gives updated plugins for the new Teamspeak 3 client and additional changes.
[list]
[*]New plugins for Teamspeak 3 client with API 21
[*]VFW speed of encoding is increased
[*]Corrected pure encoder performance test
[*]Added ability to write separate webcam file if webcam overlay is not visible (but it must not be disabled)
[*]Fixed wrong separate webcam file writing when webcam overlay is turned off
[*]Fixed error capturing audio on some systems with Realtek audio hardware when driver reports bad configuration
[/list]
Here is an additional information about how to setup teamspeak plugins. We know three possible plugins locations where TS3 client can find its plugins. Unfortunately, we don't know which are more important.
[olist]
[*]Old style - [i]plugins[/i] subfolder in main TS3 client folder
[*]New style - [i]%APPDATA%\TS3Client\plugins[/i] folder (by default it is [i]C:\Users\[b]username[/b]\AppData\Roaming\TS3Client\plugins[/i], where [b]username[/b] is your windows login name)
[*]Additional way - [i]config\plugins[/i] subfolder in main TS3 client folder
[/olist]
Copy both plugins into one of these folders (or better into all these folders), then run Teamspeak 3 and check add-ons settings. You can find plugins in [i]tools[/i] subfolder of main PlayClaw folder.

notes.title: A new PlayClaw build with the Window capture overlay!
notes.content:
We've just released a new feature - Window capture overlay in PlayClaw 5 build #3670.

You can now set a window which will be captured by PlayClaw and then rendered over a game screen or/and in a video or a stream. The chroma key effect is also applicable to this overlay.

Other major changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed DeadSpace 2 compatibility
[*]Fixed confusing error messages for some desktop recording conditions
[*]If PlayClaw terminates abnormally, then it will try to release locked DLLs to avoid problems during the next start or software update
[*]Fixed rare crash after AMD H.264 encoder is stopped
[*]Fixed wrong hardware AMD H.264 detection for some video devices
[/list]

p.s. please note, Chroma key DLC is required to use this feature with Window capture overlay (both with Webcam overlay)

notes.title: Moving your license to Steam
notes.content: Are you are already PlayClaw license owner but want to move to the Steam version of PlayClaw? Not a problem. There are two rules you must agree to: 1. You must have a Hardcore license. If you have a Light or Standard license you will need to pay the difference between your license and Hardcore license. Send email message to support@sytexis.com for details on how to do this. 2. Your Hardcore license will be disabled. If you agree, send an email message with your request to support@sytexis.com. Do not forget to include your activation code!

notes.title: Now Available - PlayClaw
notes.content:
PlayClaw 5 is Now Available on Steam.
The amazing PlayClaw video capture tool gives customers incredible power!

PlayClaw has been designed to make full use of multi-core processors, which ensures the outstanding quality of the output with a minimal impact on system performance. PlayClaw will record full HD videos of your gameplay with high frame rates with your audio commentary with no performance hit!

The other nifty feature is PlayClaw’s ability to render helpful overlays over game screen. PlayClaw will show you who's speaking in games using Ventrilo or Teamspeak, leading to better teamwork. Check your GPU/CPU load and temperatures right in game with PlayClaw's overlays. Overlays are fully compatible with the latest versions of Windows and graphics engines.
